## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets the `develop` branch (not `main`)
- [ ] `npm run test:all` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation (README / docs) is updated if user-facing behavior changes
- [ ] PR title and description are written in English
